files.content:
# Pixel Tip Calculator

An offline browser tip calculator with a pixel-art interface. Enter a bill amount, choose a 10%, 15%, or 20% tip, and set the number of people. The app shows the tip amount and total per person.

## How to run

Open `index.html` directly in any modern browser. No packages, network access, or server required.

## Files

- `index.html` — semantic markup and labeled controls
- `style.css` — responsive pixel-art layout and control states
- `script.js` — tip calculation and event handling

## Features

- Tip percent buttons: 10%, 15%, 20%
- Bill amount and number-of-people inputs
- Live tip amount and total-per-person outputs
- Keyboard-accessible controls with visible focus states
- Responsive layout from 360px wide

output.explanation: A self-contained pixel-art tip calculator built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It uses only local files, keyboard-accessible labeled inputs and buttons, addEventListener-based behavior, a responsive centered card, and a cohesive five-color palette.

output.goal: Build an offline browser app that calculates tip amount and total per person from bill amount, tip percentage (10%, 15%, 20%), and number of people, using only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript with a polished pixel-art interface.

phases.name: Setup and Semantic Structure
tasks: Create root index.html with linked style.css and script.js using relative paths
Create README.md describing the app, file structure, and how to run it offline
Build semantic markup for bill amount, tip percent buttons, number of people, tip output, and total per person
Add accessible labeled controls and include empty addEventListener stubs

phases.name: Tip Calculation Logic
tasks: Implement calculation for tip amount, total bill, and total per person
Handle tip percentage buttons for 10%, 15%, and 20%
Read bill amount and number of people inputs safely
Update results on button clicks and input changes using addEventListener only
Handle edge cases such as zero people, empty bill, or non-numeric input

phases.name: Pixel Art Styling and Responsive Layout
tasks: Create a centered card or game board on a themed background using CSS or canvas
Apply a cohesive palette of 3-5 colors
Use system fonts at 16px or larger with clear visual hierarchy and generous spacing
Style hover, focus, and pressed states for all controls
Ensure layout works from 360px wide without horizontal scrolling

phases.name: Validation, Polish, and Packaging
tasks: Verify keyboard accessibility for all controls and focus indicators
Confirm no imports, packages, network requests, external assets, iframes, or server code
Test offline by opening index.html directly
Polish README with build evidence and source archive notes
Review final files use only .html, .css, .js, and .md extensions with relative paths

risks: Pixel art styling may be visually inconsistent across browsers without external assets
Custom tip buttons may not meet keyboard accessibility expectations if focus states are incomplete
Responsive layout may require extra tuning at 360px width
Offline constraint means all visuals and functionality must be self-contained without network requests
